items.title: Pay piano service invoice
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, die Rechnung binnen 20 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum zu bezahlen.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 19.11.2026. The period is phrased as 'ab Rechnungsdatum' (from the invoice date), i.e. the invoice date is the triggering event. Under §187(1) BGB, when a period is reckoned from an event/day, that day itself is not counted; the period starts on the following day, 20.11.2026, as day 1. Counting 20 days from there: day 1=20.11, day 11=30.11, day 20=09.12.2026 (equivalently, 19.11.2026 + 20 calendar days = 09.12.2026). 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under §193 BGB is required.

warnings: The customer address block contains a stray numeral '4471' between the street address and the postal code whose meaning (e.g. apartment number, customer number, or an OCR/layout artifact) is unclear — double-check this with the original document.

The sender's own address uses the placeholder-style town name 'Musterholzminden' and the postal code 37603 which belongs to the real town Holzminden, not 'Musterholzminden'; verify the sender's actual address and bank details (IBAN DE74 3705 0198 0005 5631 00) before paying, as this looks like a template/sample letter rather than a verified real invoice.
